Two people were killed, including a gunman who opened fire at a Citibank office campus in the Tampa, Florida, area Wednesday, prompting a massive law enforcement response as employees scrambled for safety, police said.

The shooting unfolded shortly after noon at the banking giant’s campus in Brandon, Florida, about 15 miles from Tampa, where approximately 3,200 people were working at the time, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Four dead, including Washington deputy, following domestic call shooting; another deputy on life support

A Spokane County sheriff's deputy died and another is on life support after a SWAT team was ambushed responding to a domestic violence call.

Actual Article Body:

A Spokane County sheriff's deputy was killed and another remains on life support after a gunman ambushed SWAT officers responding to a domestic violence call in Washington state (Credit: KHQ).

A Washington state sheriff's deputy has died and another remains on life support after they were ambushed while responding to a domestic violence call that turned deadly, authorities said Wednesday.

Spokane County Sheriff's Office deputies responded to a home Tuesday after a woman ran to a neighbor's house reporting that her brother had shot her, FOX 13 Seattle reported.

Responding officers learned the suspect had an active felony arrest warrant and had access to multiple guns and additional victims could be inside the home.

NYPD OFFICER SHOT, GUNMAN KILLED AFTER ARMED BARRICADED STANDOFF IN BROOKLYN: POLICE

A Spokane County Sheriff's deputy walks to a hospital where two SWAT officers were taken upon being shot during a domestic violence response call. One deputy was killed and another remains on life support but is not expected to survive. (Fox News)

The Spokane County Sheriff's Office deployed a SWAT team to assist at the home. As SWAT officers approached the house, a gunman opened fire from inside.

"SWAT team members and deputies approached the house, attempted to breach the door and were met with gunfire," Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said during a news conference.

PHILADELPHIA POLICE OFFICER KILLED, PARTNER SHOT 12 TIMES IN AMBUSH; SUSPECT FOUND HIDING IN TREE

The entrance to a hospital where two Spokane County sheriff's deputies were taken after being shot Tuesday. (Fox News)

Deputies returned fire and pulled the two wounded deputies to safety. Both deputies were rushed to a hospital along with the initial female victim who was treated for injuries that were not life-threatening.

Inside the home, investigators found one person dead, while another body was found in the yard. The suspect was also found dead on the property. Authorities have not released the identities of those who died.

PHILLY OFFICER MURDERED IN LINE OF DUTY PROMOTED TO SERGEANT AS POLICE FROM AROUND US ATTEND HIS FUNERAL

On Wednesday, the sheriff's office confirmed that one of the wounded deputies succumbed to his injuries. He is survived by his wife and two children.

"Although we know our deputies knew the risks, they bravely moved toward danger to protect others they did not know," the sheriff's office said in a statement.

"They did this with honor and with an unwavering sense of duty to their oath to serve and protect the citizens of Spokane County; they heroically placed themselves in mortal danger."

The second deputy remains on life support but is not expected to survive, according to officials.

INDIANA SHERIFF'S DEPUTY SHOT THREE TIMES IN HOSPITAL ER AFTER STOPPING TO HELP STRANDED MOTORIST

A helicopter hovers in Spokane, Wash. (Fox News)

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

"As an organ donor, arrangements are being made, and he will continue to serve others with the gift of life," the agency added.

[Source 3 — nypost.com (Bias: Right / Tabloid Conservative)] (URL: https://nypost.com/2026/11/04/us-news/2-arrested-including-boy-13-in-gang-fueled-stray-bullet-nyc-shooting-that-wounded-girl-12/):
Stated Claim / Post Context:
2 arrested – including boy, 13 – in gang-fueled stray bullet NYC shooting that wounded girl, 12

The middle-schooler was shot in her stomach and right foot at a park just three days before her birthday.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Two suspects – including a 13-year-old boy – were busted in the gang-fueled stray bullet shooting that wounded a 12-year-old girl on her way to meet a friend in the Bronx last month, cops said.

The young teen was arrested Saturday and Destin Burgess, 26, was picked up by police Tuesday, with both facing attempted murder and gun possession charges in connection to the Oct. 10 shooting in Westchester Square, authorities said.

The bloodshed broke out when the gunmen spotted nearby rivals and opened fire while shouting, “Ewok! Ewok!” — a chant affiliated with the Makk Ballas, or Mac Ballers, a street gang tied to the Bloods, law enforcement sources said at the time.

The middle-schooler took bullets to her stomach and right foot at a park on Tratman Avenue between Rowland Street and St. Peters Avenue around 8:30 p.m., according to the NYPD.

After she was shot, the terrified girl immediately called her sister, Miral Alamouri, 14, the older sibling previously told The Post.

“She was like, ‘I got shot! Oh, I’m scared,’ and I’m trying to keep her awake because you don’t want her to go to sleep and get into a coma,” Miral said.

“It’s always the wrong person at the wrong time, and that shouldn’t be happening,” the sibling said. “You go to the park to sit there and play with your friends, not to get shot.”

The young girl — who was three days away from her birthday — was taken to Montefiore Hospital by a good Samaritan who was driving past when the shooting occurred.

She required surgery on her abdomen, where doctors found holes in her colon from the bullet, and another procedure on her fractured right foot, according to her sister.

Neither the arrested teen, whose name was not released due to his age, nor Burgess – who was previously arrested for gun possession in August of 2025 – is accused of firing the shots, according to a complaint filed in Bronx Criminal Court.

The suspected gunman and one other man are still on the lam, the court doc said.

A black and tan Palmetto Armory pistol was found under the front tire of a nearby car parked near the scene, and seven loose live 9mm caliber cartridges and one live round of ammunition were also recovered, the complaint said.

Burgess was ordered held on $15,000 bail or $45,000 bond, despite prosecutors’ request for a much higher bail of $300,000 cash or $900,000 bond.

His next court appearance is scheduled for Friday, before a grand jury.

The status of the arrested teen was not immediately clear because his case is being handled in Family Court.
